_meta.direction: Replace the WordPress stock featured image with a design-sourced hero in the art direction of the seeded weekend-redesign post: a quiet textured paper field, thin precise line-work, one conceptual metaphor taken from the article's own argument, and a single warm amber accent.
_meta.note: Metaphor: the same object, coupled and decoupled. The post's own definition is that a traditional CMS bundles the content layer to the presentation layer and a headless one separates them — so the figure is one rectangle shown twice, its halves touching on the left and pulled apart on the right, with the content half filled amber. Bone field.

featuredImage.alt: Two states of one shape on a bone-coloured field: at the left a rectangle divided into halves that touch, at the right the same rectangle with its halves pulled apart, the lower one filled solid amber.
